Q1: The fix is needed in `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, which is outside this heal issue's frozen scope. How should it be delivered?
Choices:
A) Close this heal issue and file a new standalone issue (not `ai:workflow-heal`). Its `files_touched:` block lists `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, `tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_state.py` and a `changelog.d/` fragment, and it targets the default branch. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Keep this issue and let the unblock judge handle the scope block when implement refuses the out-of-scope path (re-issue or operator step).
C) Make no code change: the operator adds `read:org` to the consumer's `GH_PAT` and this issue is closed as an environment fix.
D) Change only in-scope files: the test plus a changelog note recording the defect. The `gh pr edit` call stays as it is.
Q2: Two other places call `gh pr edit`: `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:1548` (body edit) and `.github/workflows/implement.yml:6113` (label add). Should they also move to REST `gh api` in the same change?
Choices:
A) No. Fix only the retry-state write in `review_conflict_resolve.sh` and file the other two separately if they are seen failing. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Yes. Move both to `gh api -X PATCH` / the labels REST endpoint in the same PR. Both files then have to be added to the granted scope as well.
C) Move only `update_workflows.yml:1548`, because it writes a body the same way. Leave the label add in `implement.yml` alone.
